_meta.accountHolder: Vanessa Tatiane Evangelista Assink creates every Idea List in HER Amazon Associates account (amazon.com; amazon.ca through OneLink). André gives technical support only.
_meta.rules: Items are the idea’s own amazonItems search terms, never anything else. Vanessa picks the actual products inside Amazon. No prices, no product photos on the site, never a shortened or masked link. Paste the full amazon.com Idea List address into url, then into siteConfig.amazon.ideaListUrls[slug] (the Developer wires it). The affiliate tag stays empty until her account exists — no value is invented here.
_meta.disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
_meta.perMaterialLinks: Already built by the site from the same terms (src/lib/amazon.ts → https://www.amazon.com/s?k=<term>, plus &tag=<associateTag> once the tag exists). Nothing to add here.
_meta.noEmailLinks: Do not put Amazon links in emails or printables; link to the idea page instead (Amazon Associates program policies restrict links in email and offline material — Vanessa should confirm in her account).
